name: Farrealm Symbiant
body:
Prerequisites: Character level 1st only, symbiant strength racial trait.

Benefit: You gain +2 Strength, +2 Charisma in place of your other racial traits, and you can cast spells from the following list up to 3 times per day as spell-like abilities. Your caster level with these spells is equal to your character level. Any related saving throw relies on your Constitution modifier.

1st—entangle, shield, web bolt; 2nd—alter self, instant weapon, spider climb, web, web shelter.

Special: You still gain the additional RP from symbiant strength if your host race’s ability scores were worth more than 0.
